correctness.rationale: Every host edge has a unique u→v encoding; compatibility requires distinct tails and heads outside the tail set. Saturation is exactly surjectivity f:U→[n]\U, giving I_n and M_n Stirling formulas and minimum ceil(n/2). Even optimum configurations are oriented perfect matchings, and swaps only flip one orientation, yielding (2m-1)!! disjoint Q_m. Odd optimum is a centered 3-block plus m−1 oriented pairs; its degree is 3(m−1), and the explicit R5 paths plus relabeling/transposition generation yield connectivity for every odd n≥5; n=3 is 3 isolated. An independently constructed surjection-enumeration reconfiguration census for n=3..8 reproduced degrees and component sizes; finite data are corroboration only.
residual_risks: The odd connectivity relies on realizing every transposition via local five-label moves; explicitly inspected rather than inferred from finite n.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Induced matchings are independent sets in the square of the line graph, so optimum maximal induced matchings are minimum maximal independent sets in L(S(K_n))^2; induced edge domination, strong matching and token jumping are other names.
